title: OCSF Process object
description: OCSF Process object as defined in OCSF v1.3. Additional fields are permitted for OCSF extension. See ADR-0006.

uid.description: Per-process-instance unique identifier. Format: <agent_id_canonical>:<pid_decimal>:<created_time_unix_nanos_utc> per ADR-0011 §6. Byte-level reproducibility enforced by SPEC-005 test fixtures.

created_time.description: Process creation time as nanoseconds since Unix epoch, UTC strict. Same format used inside process.uid per ADR-0011 §6. For activity_id=1 (Launch): the ETW event timestamp. For activity_id=2 (Terminate): the original Launch timestamp if available to the agent at Terminate time; otherwise null. See ADR-0011 §4 amendment 2026-05-23 part (a).

exit_code.description: Process exit status from Windows ExitStatus (signed int32). NTSTATUS codes appearing as large positives in unsigned-hex Windows convention will appear as negative integers here. Only meaningful for activity_id=2 (Terminate); see SPEC-005 for the v0.1 emission contract on conditional presence. See ADR-0011 §4 amendment 2026-05-23 part (b).
